notes: Parent Lennox; related Lennox-family brands listed on the page, but the page does not state they share this system, so no sister is claimed and no usesStylesOf is set. Style 1 ships year-only: its month is a 5th-position letter under a chart that exists only as an image (Style-1_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png); the repo Lennox month table is deliberately NOT imported because the Lennox page's current chart is a different image file (Lennox-Style-1-new.jpg) and month-letter mappings differ between brands. Page Style 2 is HELD entirely: both month (7th position) and year (8th position) are chart letters with no text table (image Style-2_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png). Page Style 3 ships year-only: its month is a 3rd-position chart letter (image Air-Ease.png) and its day field (1st-2nd positions) has no schema field, so neither is encoded. Page Style 4 ships in full (year digits + week digits, both text-stated).

styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year; 5th position = month letter (chart image only, held). Page example shown as 1606 B13871.

styles.era: 10-character serials, day + month letter + 2-digit year + letters + digits (page Style 3)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = day (no schema field, not encoded), 3rd position = month letter (chart image Air-Ease.png only, held), 4th-5th positions = year. Page section example shown as 15 A 67 JA098; the list header truncates it to 15 A 67 JA09, the section form is used.
Page positions 7-8 = year, 9-10 = week. Page example shown as 41407203 28.
